text: {"lessons":["Recent price movements and my short record do not show a dependable way to predict next month’s prices; I should avoid chasing gains or reacting to losses.","Selling some Stock B after a gain and Stock D after a loss, then buying across all five stocks, did not clearly improve my results; trades should follow a deliberate allocation plan, not the urge to act.","My account has experienced substantial declines and a rebound, so I should assess total portfolio risk and diversification while respecting my discomfort with losses, rather than letting average cost or short-term performance dictate decisions."]}
